gas_only_path: 1. Register schema once via SchemaRegistry.register(schema, resolverAddress=0x0, revocable=false) if no matching schema UID yet; record schemaUID.
2. Encode attestation data with SchemaEncoder for bytes32 sha256, string as_of, string did.
3. Call EAS.attest({schema: schemaUID, data: {recipient: 0x0 or CSOAI address, expirationTime: 0, revocable: false, refUID: 0x0, data: encoded}}).
Cost: Base gas only (permissionless; no protocol fee). Off-chain EAS attestations are gas-free but do not yield an on-chain UID a stranger can recompute from chain alone.
